query:
SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.aliases, c.semester, COUNT(r.id) as "resource_count!",
                    false as "pinned!"
                FROM courses c
                LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.course_id = c.id
                WHERE ($1 = '' OR c.name ILIKE $2 OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.aliases) a WHERE a ILIKE $2
                ))
                AND c.id != ALL($5)
                GROUP BY c.id
                ORDER BY c.name
                LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
